DIAGNOSIS READY: Duodenal Atresia

The abdominal X-ray showing the 'double bubble' sign is highly specific for this condition in a newborn with bilious vomiting, which rules out gastroenteritis. Please confirm if the baby has any history of polyhydramnios or if they passed meconium within the first 24 hours of life.
